name: Mirror Lake Orchard
summary: Defias bandits now hold Mirror Lake Orchard, on Mirror Lake's southern shore in western Elwynn Forest. The quiet homestead near Thunder Falls has fallen to outlaws while Stormwind's guards are stretched thin.

sections.title: A Grove Under Seizure
sections.body: Mirror Lake Orchard once fed a peaceful farmstead with the clean waters of Mirror Lake. Now Defias Brotherhood bandits have seized the cottage and grounds near Thunder Falls. With Stormwind's military stretched thin and King Varian Wrynn missing, rural homes across Elwynn are easy targets for outlaws seeking shelter.

faq.q: Who controls Mirror Lake Orchard right now?
aliases: who is at mirror lake orchard
faq.answer: Defias bandits occupy Mirror Lake Orchard and its cottage. The honest folk who once tended the trees have been driven away, and the secluded grounds now give the outlaws a base in western Elwynn.

faq.q: Where is Mirror Lake Orchard located?
faq.answer: Mirror Lake Orchard lies on the southern shore of Mirror Lake in western Elwynn Forest, just east of Thunder Falls and north of the main road toward Westfall.

faq.q: Why hasn't Stormwind reclaimed the orchard?
faq.answer: Stormwind's standing army is largely absent from rural Elwynn amid political deadlock and the mysterious disappearance of King Varian Wrynn. With local garrisons short-handed, distant farms and orchards are often left to face the Defias Brotherhood alone.

faq.q: What is the connection between the orchard and Thunder Falls?
faq.answer: Mirror Lake drains into Thunder Falls, and the orchard sits just above the cascade. Its secluded place near the cliffs gives bandits a defensible position.

angles.text: For Alliance travelers, the occupied orchard is another sign of the Defias Brotherhood's bold advance across the kingdom's heartland.
As a Rogue, you can see the Defias strategy in the orchard: seize overlooked, defensible ground near water and cliffs to watch the roads and evade city patrols.
